notes: This minor release adds the 57 policies merged since rules 0.3.1, growing the stream from 181 to 238 policy source files: opt-in code-smell policies (nesting, parameters, function size and complexity, cleanup flow, repeated literals, Python assert-true), PHP and C++ selected-boundary network-effect policies, and Python CodeQL quality policies. Existing policy bytes, IDs, required capabilities and typed incomplete outcomes are unchanged. It pins its native pack dependency to 0.5.0, the native content regenerated with the Bifrost 0.14.0 release-candidate generator. Source integrity and focused publication smoke remain separate from full engine and policy qualification.
